blurb: Milla Dance Fit offers ballet classes for ages 3 and up, focusing on technique and artistic education. They also provide jazz dance classes and etiquette classes for young children. Classes emphasize discipline, technique, and social skills in a fun and professional environment.
extraNote: Monthly tuition is due on the day you start taking classes and must be paid no later than the first scheduled class of the month. · Tuition payments not made by the 8th of the month will be assessed a $25 late fee. · Students will not be allowed to participate in class if tuition payment is late (after the 8th of the month). · Please arrive 10 minutes before your class start time to allow for check-in. · No physical contact between dancers at any time.
